Alternatively, you can create poll by mentioning me with question and answers. e.g *@Absolute Poll "Your Question" "Answer 1" "Answer 2"*

Here’s the final schedule for Sophia Elaina Andrade’s Celebration of Life!
– Friday, 9/5/25. Thank you all for being part of this day — let’s keep things smooth, respectful, and full of love. 💛

⸻

🕕 6:00 PM – Setup
👥 Marco / Clint / Pastor Frank / Assistants
• 🎛️ Test audio & visuals
• 🪑 Arrange chairs & seating
• 🌸 Set up flowers & Sunday bar
• 📖 Prepare guestbook & tables

⸻

🕖 7:00 PM – Opening
🙏 Welcome & Prayer – Pastor Frank
📖 Scriptures: Psalm 23, 1 Corinthians 15:55–57

⸻

🕢 7:20 PM – Walk of Honor Tribute
🎤 Family Speakers

⸻

⸻
